shots.description: Cover: 5-star BCPD chase at golden hour — Air One helicopter overhead, roadblock ahead, player car with NOS flame, wanted stars and minimap on the HUD
Street Cred race: player car at checkpoint 1 of 8 on the downtown grid, mission objective and race marker visible
Last Stand: safehouse defense shootout at the Hideout — SWAT wave incoming, 5 stars, player on foot with the weapon wheel HUD
Title screen over Neon Bay at golden hour with wet streets and neon reflections as the hurricane closes in
